page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top ("Roma Irreconciliabilis.") with page number 7 at right. One column of text in the centre, with a narrow marginal note at the right of the column. Below the text, a signature line "B 4" with catchword "(que" at right.

main_text.p: tum tuum abijt in scorias, merum tuum aqua infpurcatum est. Apage matris imperium! vna omnes eademque Ecclefia sumus (externæ vocationis merito) quotquot vbiuis terrarum Iesum Christum, Dei filium, vnicum mundi Seruatorem colimus, idemque communis fidei symbolum profitemur ; purius hoc alij facimus, alij verò corruptius ; Christiani sumus interea omnes, sani non sumus. At quàm temerè (inquis) ista ; quæque conciliatore ipsa nimis indigeant ; vna vt sit Ecclesia, quæ tamen Conciliari nescit? Certè ; Exterioris formæ dignitasIren. lib. 1. c. 2. 3.

page.notes: Marginal note at right reads "Iren. lib.1. c.2.3." The faint show-through text in the right margin below the note (Cypr. ep. 73?) is not transcribed. Words "quæque" and "ipsa" and "Conciliari" are as printed; some letters in the scan are faint. The catchword "(que" is partly cut off.
